hypothesis: The strong v283 ranking may retain systematic stage-wise overconfidence or lane bias. A low-dimensional calibration that exactly factorizes its 120 probabilities into first, second-given-first, and third-given-pair distributions can improve exact-top3 logloss without replacing the parent ranking model.

structure.lane_bias_centering: subtract mean bias within each stage
structure.parent_reconstruction_test: unmodified conditionals must reconstruct all 120 v283 probabilities

training.d7: fit all three calibrators only on D6 chronological history and predict D7
training.d8: fit all three calibrators only on D6 plus D7 chronological history and predict D8

promotion_requires: mean delta versus v283 below zero, race-date bootstrap CI95 upper below zero, and v283 child-family Holm-adjusted p below 0.05
difference_from_v279: v279 trained flexible feature-dependent LightGBM conditional residuals. v291 is a 21-parameter parent-only calibration with no race or runner features and is initialized to exactly reproduce v283.
